late_history_evidence.worker: history_reconcile_worker NOLOGIN with EXECUTE only on governed sweep/finalize surfaces and no direct provider-history mutation or trigger-admin authority
late_history_evidence.coverage_semantics: only overlapping/touching runs from exact current authority generation and exact current provider dataset revision whose durable provider_snapshot_at satisfies owner-required currentness form continuous coverage
late_history_evidence.provider_mutation_invalidation: owner-visible INSERT/UPDATE increments provider_dataset_revision and invalidates materialized coverage atomically; stable identity rewrite, DELETE and TRUNCATE fail closed
late_history_evidence.stable_identity_content: existing accepted stream_id plus observation_id content is immutable; observed_at or numeric_value mismatch rejects before reconciliation_run
late_history_evidence.cross_window_identity_validation: conflict validation occurs when either accepted or owner-current observed_at intersects requested window
late_history_evidence.visibility_shift_validation: for an already accepted stable identity, canonical conflict validation is independent of provider became_visible_at; became_visible_at filters only insertion of previously unaccepted rows
late_history_evidence.visibility_shift_negative: owner correction moves accepted 11:58 observation to observed_at 12:01, became_visible_at 12:30 and changed value while snapshot remains 12:00; fresh 11:00..12:00 sweep rejects and mints no coverage
late_history_evidence.conflict_failure_atomicity: rejected conflicting sweep preserves accepted canonical content and does not mint coverage
late_history_evidence.history_runner_completeness_guard: workflow enumerates existing 00[4-9]_history_*.sql files and fails if any are not referenced by run_conformance_extended.sh; exact anchor reports history_modules=5
late_history_evidence.unrecoverable_retention_loss: explicit durable gap; never false complete

recovery_evidence.restore_boundary: baseline exercises two independent physical PostgreSQL restores from the same committed R backup; hardening additionally physically copies PGDATA after restored identity enrollment
recovery_evidence.surviving_authority: separate external control PostgreSQL not included in source backup/restore
recovery_evidence.grant_storage: structured typed columns plus canonical payload, HMAC attestation, claimed principal, claimed instance id, claimed instance fingerprint and claim timestamp
recovery_evidence.grant_canonical_field_encoding: UTF-8 byte length in decimal + ':' + lowercase UTF-8 hex
recovery_evidence.grant_authentication: HMAC-SHA-256 with random key generated and stored only in surviving external authority
recovery_evidence.claim_api: baseline claim_grant(grant_id, instance_id, instance_secret) and verify_claimed_grant(grant_id, instance_id, instance_secret); caller never supplies principal identity or signed grant facts
recovery_evidence.baseline_instance_capability_origin: each independent restore generates random instance_id and 256-bit instance_secret only after reaching R
recovery_evidence.baseline_instance_capability_binding: surviving authority atomically binds grant to session_user plus instance_id plus domain-separated SHA-256 fingerprint of instance_secret
recovery_evidence.baseline_same_external_credential_negati: primary and second independent physical restore use the exact same external role/password; rival has different post-R capability and is rejected
recovery_evidence.post_enrollment_pgdata_clone_timing: physical PGDATA copy occurs after database-visible restored identity and proof helper are enrolled
recovery_evidence.post_enrollment_effective_capability_loc: evidence-only read-only per-instance file mount outside PostgreSQL PGDATA
recovery_evidence.independent_claim_race: two independently authenticated principals/capabilities race a dedicated grant and exactly one wins
recovery_evidence.evidence_identity_mechanism: baseline database-local capability plus final post-enrollment hardening with effective proof outside PGDATA and same-path positive control; both are C2 falsification machinery
recovery_evidence.production_requirement: production recovery identity must preserve genuinely non-shareable per-restored-instance authority beyond reusable external credentials and copyable recovered database state; exact TPM/TEE/KMS/workload-identity mechanism remains unselected

relocation_evidence.source_inflight_acceptance_race: acceptance holding placement lock commits before fence and is included in F
relocation_evidence.canonical_field_encoding: UTF-8 byte length in decimal + ':' + lowercase UTF-8 hex
relocation_evidence.canonical_timestamp_encoding: finite UTC microseconds plus explicit AD/BC era; non-finite exact -infinity/infinity
relocation_evidence.canonical_numeric_encoding: finite numeric trim_scale text; exact NaN, Infinity and -Infinity sentinels

relocation_evidence.projection_writer: ts_automation_owner with projection DML but without checkpoint/key ownership or freeze-disable authority

crypto_evidence_boundary.rule: every structured message protected by hash/HMAC must first have deterministic versioned injective or equivalently unambiguous field framing, and each typed value must itself have a total injective canonical representation over the full accepted domain
crypto_evidence_boundary.canonical_encoding: bounded evidence representation using UTF-8 byte-length plus lowercase hex
crypto_evidence_boundary.timestamp_rule: finite timestamptz uses UTC microseconds plus explicit AD/BC; non-finite uses exact -infinity/infinity
crypto_evidence_boundary.numeric_rule: finite numeric uses trim_scale canonical text; NaN, Infinity and -Infinity use distinct exact reserved literals
crypto_evidence_boundary.target_checkpoint_hmac_sha256: bounded evidence integrity mechanism with effective key generated and retained inside target authority
crypto_evidence_boundary.recovery_grant_hmac_sha256: bounded evidence integrity mechanism over canonical_grant
crypto_evidence_boundary.issuer_verifier_separation: verification capability excludes signing/mint capability; Tier 1 has no target signing key

privileged_automation_boundary.production_requirement: connection/authentication admission, pg_hba/socket/network exposure and role-membership policy must prevent tenant/application principals from authenticating as or assuming ts_automation_owner
